description: Source Freshness / Result TTL: how long can your agent reuse a result before paying to fetch it again? The source's own Last-Modified, ETag and Cache-Control + a reuse window by data kind (price, quote, hours, weather, news, stock, crypto, business_facts, terms, docs, filing, profile, search) + how to revalidate cheaply (304). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/freshness, $0.001 via x402.)
